scene_type: 2D (top-down / nadir view of a flat ground plane; mild perspective parallax for tall parts, see notes)
units: pixels, seconds; image x to the right, y down

camera.motion: static (floor's faint texture is identical in all frames; median background is clean)
camera.view: looking straight down at a uniform grey floor (~RGB 151), no horizon, no markings
camera.perspective_cues: Tall parts are displaced radially away from the image centre (~960,540): rider head minus bicycle centre goes from +52 px at bike x=1711 to +3 px at bike x=478 (slope ~0.040 px/px). Bicycle pixel length grows slightly with x: len ~ 373.2 + 0.0072*x (376 px at x~480, 386 px at x~1710; ~2.5% change) - slight camera tilt or lens effect. Treat as 2D with one scale; perspective is a ~2-5% effect.

duplicate_frames: frames 0 and 1 are pixel-identical (no motion between them for both objects); motion starts at frame 1->2

pedestrian.description: man in white T-shirt, dark hair, dark blue-grey jeans, black shoes, walking to the RIGHT (+x) along y~440 in the upper-left part of the frame
pedestrian.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = centroid of the dark hair (head) blob seen from above; smooth. Pelvis lies under it; head x is displaced ~-30..-45 px toward the left image edge by parallax vs. feet, so pelvis x is probably ~10-25 px right of head x. Mask/bbox centres also given (they oscillate with the stride).

extents_px.along_motion_x_bbox: 124-225 (stride dependent; min ~117-124 at frames 16-18 legs together, max ~225 at frames 25-26)

cyclist.description: rider in black jacket on a light-cyan (turquoise) bicycle with a rear rack, riding to the LEFT (-x) along y~641 in the lower half; front wheel points left
cyclist.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = centre of the bounding box of the cyan bicycle pixels (wheel-to-wheel midpoint), a ground-level root proxy. Front-wheel tip = bike_bbox_x0.
cyclist.motion_character: steady, essentially constant pixel speed (per-frame steps 46-49 px, jitter from 1-2 px quantisation)

extents_px.bicycle_length_x: 376-386 (mean 381.0) over frames 2-28; frames 0-1 cut by edge (355 visible)

static_objects: none (plain grey floor, no markings or props). Soft dark shadows around both figures (not part of masks).
